description: Performance Manager's declared dependency contract on the upstream Rill ML repository. Rill is an EXTERNAL runtime owned, built and released by its upstream repository; this repository never compiles or natively tests Rill. The PM-side contract is the independent 'pm-rill-shadow' v1 protocol (deliberately distinct from Rill Runtime IPC API v1/v2/v3). The upstream release entry is authoritative: it pins the exact tag, tag commit, artifact URL and SHA-256 consumed by the packaged performance-manager-rill integration. A missing/invalid entry keeps the Core capability gate fail-closed.
versionRangeSemantics: runtime must satisfy pm-rill-shadow protocolVersion==1 and every required capability; higher unknown protocol major is NOT assumed compatible; missing runtime, unreachable service or protocol mismatch is fail-closed. Rill Runtime IPC API and the PM adapter protocol are different contracts.

upstream.verifiedBy: independent host smoke on the published binary (SHA-256 + size match signed index)
upstream.note: The pinned adapter is advisory-only and never mutates OpenWrt/UCI/sysctl/ethtool state. All mutations remain in PM Core. The x86/64 RC gate consumes the linux-x86_64-musl artifact; linux-aarch64-musl is provisioned for the next target and is not yet backed by a Remote OpenWrt SDK target build.
